row.Exposure / conditions: CTI report A2240623890101, supplied sample Bambu PC FR C01-xx;128×12.9×3.3mm. Test UL94-2023 vertical burning at23±2°C50±5%RH; precondition23±2°C50±10%RH48h and separately70°C168h followed by calcium chloride desiccator≥4h.20±1mm flame applied twice10±0.5s. Room and aged five-specimen sets meetV-0. Report limits results to tested samples; client identification not verified by CTI. Specimen manufacturing/printed form, build orientation, nozzle recipe and colour not stated. No universal printed-part certification or continuous service/fire design allowable. Report p.5 restricts data/results to scientific research, education, internal quality control and product development etc.
